title: Turning Windows-only USB gadgets into open Python drivers with usb-rea
summary:
Every desk has one: an RGB controller, a PC-case LCD, a fan hub, a "smart" lamp that only works with a Windows vendor app. On Linux it's a paperweight.
The usual fix is hours in Wireshark: click a slider, stare at hex, click again, diff by eye. usb-rea automates that loop.

Capture USB traffic: usbmon on Linux, USBPcap/Wireshark on Windows.
Label every click: usb-rea mark "fan 1200", usb-rea mark "color 255 0 0".
usb-rea diffs the packets per action and infers each byte's role.
You get report.md
